goal: bn-integration: winter from autumn (--season autumn --advance-ticks 25000), seed 103. Stopped at winter start when the coordinator switched trees.

findings.title: Season box: 'N rotting' sits oddly beside the food total
findings.detail: Last autumn night: 'Food: 17 of 14 for winter, 5 rotting' (1 member). 5 rotting is more than the 3 above target, and nothing says what rots or where.

findings.title: Purchase Food / Sell Resources look pressable in a stall-less camp
findings.detail: Inside a camp with 0 stalls, the command bar shows Purchase Food and Sell Resources in the enabled style.

findings.title: Objective progress lags inventory
findings.detail: The objective showed 'Wood 44/50' while the player carried 50 (state.json); it caught up a few seconds later. The same lag shows on bn-full.

verdict: The 'no members yet' line, the world-event sheet's long-wait note and the em-dash fix all show correctly. Winter itself was measured on bn-full (w2f) instead.
